fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole 2015 Ram 1500 pickup.
findings: Loose wires and a phone cable hanging from the dash by the steering column
Dirty, scuffed camo floor mat on the driver side
Hat and loose items on the dash and passenger side of the cab
Light dust and smudges on the dash and center console
Exterior paint looks fairly clean and glossy from the side shots
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Ram 1500. The outside looks sharp, but the cab photos show a dirty floor mat, some dust on the dash and loose items and cables up front. We do mobile pre-sale interior and exterior details and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
